Name: Android compatibility patch for Alternative Textures 8.1.1
Author: KhaStark
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS]Alternative Textures 8.1.1 can cause farm animals to use their normal walking frames while they are actually swimming. The animal enters the water correctly, but a sprite texture reload during Alternative Textures' farm-animal draw path can reset Stardew Valley's already-selected swimming source rectangle back to the land frame.

Alternative Textures Farm Animal Swimming Fix - Android is a small companion SMAPI mod which preserves the swimming frame during that draw path.

This release is Android-only. The DLL checks the platform at runtime and does not apply its Harmony patch on desktop/PC builds.

The mod does not replace or modify AlternativeTextures.dll.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Stardew Valley 1.6.15.3 or later on Android.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS]SMAPI 4.3.2 or later for Android.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Comic Sans MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures 8.1.1 by PeacefulEnd[/url][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
[b]Optional[/b]
[/font]
[list]

[*][font=Comic Sans MS]Like a Duck to Water is not required by this fix, but it is compatible in the tested Android setup and can make eligible farm animals enter water more readily.[/font][/*]
[/list][font=Comic Sans MS]
